reviews.title: Navigation changes
reviews.text: Do not like the navigation changes when importing new recipes to add main ingredients, tags, etc. Went from efficient process to inefficient.

reviews.title: The updated version 4 is awful
reviews.text:
am not keen on the V4 version at all. When cooking it was better to have visibility of the ingredients to the side of the cooking instructions. Otherwise you have to keep scrolling up and down to see what ingredient and back to the top to see the method. I have reverted back but, the font size has reduced significantly for some reason.

Please help as I loved the app but it’s frustrating. Even trying to reset to V3 that’s not working!

reviews.title: Annoyed
reviews.text: Was free until it wasn’t. That’s all I have to say. Lost my recipes bc of this. Thanks.
